name: DescribeEIURange

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

This parameter can be left empty when Operation is set to Buy.

This parameter is required when Operation is set to Upgrade or Downgrade.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
当Operation为Buy时，该参数可以为空。
当Operation为Upgrade或Downgrade时，该参数必填。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the compute resources.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469002.html operation to query the specifications of compute resources
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源规格。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469002.html接口查看计算资源规格
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

Buy: Purchase a cluster.

Modify: Change the specifications of a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型，取值说明：
Buy：新购集群。
Modify：变配集群
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the region ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster version. Valid values:

3.0 (default): Data Lakehouse Edition.

5.0: includes Data Lakehouse Edition, Enterprise Edition, and Basic Edition
parameters.help_zh:
集群版本，取值说明：
3.0（默认值）：数仓版。
5.0：包括湖仓版、企业版和基础版
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html operation to query the zone ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html接口查看集群的可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the storage resources. The default value is 8ACU. Valid values:

8ACU

12ACU

16ACU

存储资源规格，默认规格为8ACU，取值范围：
8ACU
12ACU
16ACU

parameters.help_en:

Upgrade: Upgrade a cluster.

Downgrade: Downgrade a cluster

子操作类型，取值说明：
Upgrade：升配集群。
Downgrade：降配集群
parameters.name: sub_operation

parameters.help_en:
The edition. Valid values:

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition.

BasicVersion: Basic Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本：
EnterpriseVersion：企业版。
BasicVersion：基础版
